adjudication.rationale: The diff does change `basePath(store, type)` globally in `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6` by checking `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-'))`. That transformation applies to every REST type and only replaces the first underscore, so any admin model name containing multiple underscores would not be fully normalized and could fail the `/admin/` routing check. However, the diff does not show an actual existing model that would be misrouted today (current affected names like `site_customization`/`embeddable_host` have only one underscore), so it’s more of a scope/robustness concern than a proven defect.
